visual_requirements.description: White male deity holding a clearly readable mace, fully covered by opaque Indian ceremonial garments; one head, two arms as conservative humanlike depiction.
A physically coherent three-wheeled chariot pulled by exactly three white horses; all three wheels made legible through oblique forward view.
Moonlight shines onto the active chariot procession and surrounding foliage; no invented destruction, magical beams or elemental storm.
Night sky with lunar disk and dark vegetation, drawn from his moon/night/plants domain.

correction_target: Ordinary man standing before the moon at human scale.
research_note: Current show-entry includes added c09 iconography; embedded old ledger research only has c01-c06.
targeted_edit: Add an opaque ivory high-neck long-sleeved under-tunic fully covering torso, shoulders and arms, with rest of image invariant.
